text:
Alex L: Heads-up — saw 2 OOMs on canary today when running mixed-token load (chat + batch-embeds). GPUs were at ~95% mem, but free lists look fragmented.
Jin K: Do you have the per-request alloc trace? fragmentation + large logits scratchpad seems likely.
Alex L: Pasted the short trace from the instance: `oom: alloc 1.2GB for logits_buf; available 512MB; free_list entries 84 small, 3 medium, 0 large`
Maya R: That matches a regression I saw after the kernel-selection change (v2.9) — we reduced eager free of logits to avoid double-free noise, but that left larger contiguous slabs held.
Jin K: Ran a quick profile:
```
perf_summary:
  avg_seq_len: 512
  avg_batch: 6
  logits_peak: 1.15GB
  scratchpad_peak: 420MB
  kv_cache_active: 2.1GB
  fragmented_free_total: 350MB
```
Jin K: Flamegraph link: https://perf.internal/runs/2056/flame-2056 (hot path shows `prepare_logits_scratch -> allocate_slab -> fallback_host_staging`)
Alex L: Idea: enable pool-swap fallback for cold KV/tensor slots so we can evict rarely-used slabs to pinned host memory. That would let us reclaim contiguous device slabs for logits.
Maya R: Agree. We should gate it behind a conservative threshold and measure perf delta. Proposed flags: `pool_swap_enabled=true`, `pool_swap_threshold=0.25` (evict when fragmentation leaves <25% contiguous), `pool_swap_dma=true` for pinned-host DMA transfers.
Jin K: Quick micro-benchmark with `pool_swap_enabled=true` shows ~+3% latency p95 for short requests, but tail p99 for long sequences drops by ~8% since fewer OOM-driven fallbacks. Raw numbers: p95 from 48ms -> 49.5ms, p99 from 620ms -> 570ms.
perf-bot: Canary deploy started for `pool-swap-fallback` (tag: pr-5423) on 3 nodes in us-west-2.
deploy-bot: Canary logs: 2056 nodes show 0 OOMs in last 2h; baseline had 7 OOMs.
Maya R: Two implementation notes: 1) we must avoid moving hot KV entries — use LRU with usage counters from the KV accessor; 2) overlapping async DMA must respect the runtime's timeline to avoid stalling kernel dispatch.
Alex L: For rollout plan: canary -> 50% -> full after 48h with metrics: OOM count, p99 latency, GPU mem compaction frequency, and memory copy/sec to host.
Jin K: I'll add perf counters + a small tracing flag: `POOL_SWAP_TRACE=1` which prints per-eviction size and reason. Example output:
```
[pool-swap] evict slab id=0x7f3 size=128MB reason=low_contig free_after=0.12 contig_ratio=0.18
```
Alex L: Great. Action items: Jin add trace + microbench, Maya add LRU threshold tuning, I'll coordinate canary metrics. Thanks :thumbsup:
